title: Kalita Wave brewing guide
scope: Current Ozone Wave 155 single-cup recipe using matching Wave 155 paper; separate current Wave 185 variant and model-specific care.

sources.title: Kalita Wave Brew Guide
supports: Current Wave 155 15 g/250 g and Wave 185 30 g/500 g recipes at 93 C; masses, start times, finish cues; matching paper sizes and taste adjustments.

sources.title: Kalita Wave 185 Stainless Steel Coffee Dripper
supports: Flat bottom and three outlets; requires Wave 185 filters; stainless construction, preheating, dishwasher-safe care.

sources.title: Kalita Wave 185 Glass Dripper
supports: Heat-resistant glass and polypropylene collar; manufacturer response requires collar for stability; Wave 185 paper, preheating, dishwasher-safe care.

sources.title: Kalita MINO Ceramic Dripper 185 - Sand Beige
supports: Specific ceramic Wave 185 construction, three-hole base, matching185 filters, preheating and dishwasher-safe care.

recipe.name: Ozone current Wave 155 single cup: 15 g / 250 g
equipment: Stable heat-safe mug or server with serving headroom
recipe.grind_description: Medium filter grind. Visible small grains rather than flour is an app-authored texture cue; no exact grinder setting is established.

expected_time_s.clock_start: First water contact with coffee; start timer simultaneously.
expected_time_s.clock_end: Bed drained and dripping essentially stopped; finish range is guidance.

recipe.completion_signal: Bed drained and dripping essentially stopped, then remove brewer.

steps.instruction: Seat Wave 155 paper centrally; preserve pleats. Check clean outlets, stable vessel and headroom.
steps.why: App-authored checks keep the intended paper and exit path available.
steps.completion: Correct paper installed, outlets clear, brewer stable.

steps.instruction: Rinse paper with extra hot water, discard rinse, add 15 g coffee, level gently, tare assembled setup.
steps.why: Rinse wets paper and warms equipment; tare makes subsequent scale readings cumulative brew-water input.
steps.completion: Wet paper, level grounds; scale zero with all brew equipment loaded.

steps.instruction: At first wetting start timer; add 50 g gently across all grounds. Wait until elapsed 30 s.
steps.why: The initial wetting allows degassing before the main additions.
steps.completion: All grounds wetted; timer reaches 30 s from first contact, not 30 s after pouring.

steps.instruction: At 30 s add 100 g: about50 g in gentle circles, then50 g centrally. Do not tare.
steps.why: Maintain the recipe's planned distribution and cumulative input.
steps.completion: Scale reads 150 g; pause earlier if water threatens the rim.

steps.instruction: At 70 s add 100 g using the same circular then central pattern.
steps.why: Completes the planned input while keeping the pouring pattern repeatable.
steps.completion: Scale reads 250 g; keep water safely below paper rim.

steps.instruction: Let drain, then remove brewer onto a suitable surface and serve.
steps.why: Collect the brew before removing the hot equipment; time is a diagnostic cue.
steps.completion: Bed drained and dripping essentially stopped; typical source range 150–180 s total.

editorial_adaptations: Setup-first outlet and filter checks, headroom guard, handling reminders, texture cue, and cleaning sequence are app-authored practical explanations. They do not change the published recipe quantities or timing.
If liquid threatens overflow, pause pouring rather than follow the clock blindly; observe the changed timing.

variants.name: Current Ozone Wave 185 recipe
variants.how_it_differs: 30 g coffee,500 g input,93 C: add100/200/200 g at0/30/90 s to cumulative100/300/500 g; finish guidance 210–240 s. Requires Wave 185 paper and larger vessel; not an automatic155 scaling.

variants.name: Stainless185
variants.how_it_differs: Stainless construction; preheat consistently. Reviewed product is dishwasher safe.

variants.name: Glass185
variants.how_it_differs: Heat-resistant glass with polypropylene collar; retain collar for stability. Reviewed product is dishwasher safe.

variants.name: MINO ceramic185
variants.how_it_differs: Separate ceramic model with Wave 185 paper; preheat. Reviewed MINO model is dishwasher safe; do not infer identical drainage for all materials.

troubleshooting.symptom: Unexpected slow drainage or water rising toward rim
troubleshooting.check_first: App-authored inference from hardware: matching paper size, centered base, open pleats, clear three outlets and unblocked exit; pause if headroom is running out.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Inspect after cooling; if setup is sound and slowness repeats, try slightly coarser grind next brew while keeping recipe and pouring consistent.

troubleshooting.check_first: Correct masses, water temperature, even wetting and completed drawdown.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try a little finer on the next brew; change one variable and compare taste.

troubleshooting.check_first: Check the starting procedure and drainage setup before interpreting time.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Try a little coarser next time and assess taste; no mandatory finish deadline.

troubleshooting.check_first: Collar installed correctly and vessel rim supports the brewer securely before any hot water is added.
troubleshooting.adjustment: Use a suitably fitting stable vessel; do not hold an unstable dripper while brewing.

safety: Use a stable heat-safe vessel with headroom and keep the kettle controlled.
Pause pouring when water approaches the paper rim; do not press hot paper down or poke outlets during brewing.
The brewer, rinse water and coffee are hot; set the removed dripper onto a heat-safe surface.
Keep the glass185 polypropylene collar installed for stability.
After cooling discard grounds and paper, wash, rinse and dry; reviewed stainless185, glass185 and MINO ceramic185 are dishwasher safe. Follow care guidance for your own model.
Treat glass and ceramic gently; avoid knocks and abrupt temperature changes. This is app-authored conservative handling guidance.
